  while  reading the build file 'zbx.build.zon'
  cause  'zbx.build.zon' line 4, column 38: image.config .user "root" is not
         UID:GID in numbers; names are not looked up in a build
  path   zbx.build.zon
  at     line 4, column 38
  fix    write .user as "UID:GID" in numbers, for example "0:0"
